Karawan.//: Relative to this project directory, i.e. the repository root. It used to say $(SolutionDir), which is a Visual Studio MSBuild macro: VS expands it, `dotnet run` does not, so `dotnet run` fell back to the project directory and every ..-relative content lookup started one level too deep. engine.GameRoot no longer depends on the working directory at all, but leaving an unexpanded macro here would keep surprising people.
